title: Rewrite, Then Veto: Rewriter-Agnostic Edit Gating for LLM-Based Post-OCR Correction
abstract: arXiv:2611.05539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs can repair noisy OCR transcripts of historical documents, but they also change text that was already correct. We propose EditVeto, a veto gate placed after a full-context LLM rewrite. The rewrite is character-aligned to the OCR input, its differences are split into blocks, and a 0.6B-parameter gate keeps or reverts each block. An oracle analysis motivates the design: given the true error locations, per-span generation is worse than no correction, whereas vetoing a full rewrite's edits helps. Trained on rewrites by two Qwen3 models and evaluated, frozen, on the eight HIPE-OCRepair-2026 test sets, the gate improves all five rewriters tested, two of them unseen in training: weighted cMER falls by 0.0026-0.0044 and the preference score rises by 0.15-0.25 (paired bootstrap, p ~ 0.0002 each). On published competition outputs it lowers cMER for three of four teams but raises it for the winning run (0.0050 to 0.0065). In a second, disclosed

translated_title: 先改写，后否决：面向基于大语言模型后OCR纠错的重写器无关编辑门控
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够修复历史文档中含噪声的OCR转录文本，但它们也会改动原本已经正确的文字。我们提出了EditVeto，一个放置在全文上下文LLM改写之后的否决门控。改写结果与OCR输入进行字符级对齐，其差异被切分为块，再由一个0.6B参数的门控模型决定保留或撤销每个块。一项Oracle分析为该设计提供了依据：在已知真实错误位置的情况下，按跨度逐一生成比不做纠错更差，而对完整改写产生的编辑进行否决则有所助益。该门控在两个Qwen3模型生成的改写结果上训练，并以冻结状态在八个HIPE-OCRepair-2026测试集上评估。结果显示，该门控提升了所有五个受测改写器的表现（其中两个在训练中未曾见过）：加权cMER下降0.0026-0.0044，偏好得分上升0.15-0.25（配对bootstrap检验，各自p值约0.0002）。在已公布的竞赛输出上，它降低了四支队伍中三支的cMER，但使冠军队伍的cMER上升（从0.0050升至0.0065）。在第二项已公开的
tldr: 提出EditVeto——在LLM全文改写之后加一个0.6B参数的否决门控，将改写与OCR原文字符对齐、差异分块并逐块决定保留或撤销，从而以重写器无关的方式提升OCR后纠错效果，同时避免改动原本正确的文本。
en_tdlr: EditVeto is a rewriter-agnostic, 0.6B-parameter veto gate placed after full-context LLM rewrites that character-aligns the edits, splits them into blocks, and keeps or reverts each block, improving post-OCR correction across five rewriters while avoiding changes to already-correct text.
